comment: Choral - vowel-filter choir (folder and source keep the working name "formant"). Three parallel resonant band-pass filters (RBJ biquads, 4th order each) tuned to the first three formants of A E I O U; Vowel morphs between neighbouring vowels, a tempo-synced LFO (Tempo + Div, like DualShft) sweeps it back and forth. Chord (5 voices, pitch and formants) / Lag make a choir out of the filters alone; the Shape knob picks the LFO shape (sine, steps, random, solo, canon, ripple, fan ...); the main voice has a 3 kHz singer's-formant band. Footswitch off = bypass. Mono.
gid_comment: 0x08 = Delay category -> Fx_DLY_. Grouped with the rest of the pack.
fxid_comment: 480 DualShft, 485 DubSiren, 486 Choral, 487 WaveFold, 488 EuGate (this pack). Unique inside the repo; check other community effects.

params.name: Vowel
params.comment: Vowel Select (screen 0..40 = tenths): 0 A, 1 E, 2 I, 3 O, 4 U, in between = morph. Shown as five letters: AAAAA, AAAAE, AAAEE, AAEEE, AEEEE, EEEEE ...

params.name: Reso
params.comment: Sharpness of the throat: filter Q from about 2 (soft) to 33 (very vocal), two filters in series per formant. The level is lifted towards the top of the range so it does not get weaker.

params.name: Chord
params.comment: OFF, then 1..42 a close detune of the four side voices, 0.01 to 1.00 semitone (shown as that number; steps of 0.01 up to 0.20, 0.02 up to 0.40, 0.05 up to 1.00), then 2.00 to 7.00 semitones in whole steps, then the 35 chords of a classic chord-machine set: minor, Major, sus2, sus4, m7, M7, mMaj7, Maj7, 7sus4, dim7, madd9, Madd9, m6, M6, mb5, Mb5, m7b5, M7b5, M#5, m7#5, M7#5, mb6, m9no5, M9no5, M9b5 (Madd9b5), Mj7b5 (Maj7b5), M7b9 (M7b9no5), s4#5 (sus4#5b9), s4a#5 (sus4add#5), Madb5 (Maddb5), M6a4 (M6add4no5), Mj7/6 (Maj7/6no5), Mj9 (Maj9no5), 4ths (Fourths), 5ths (Fifths). The main voice is the root. The side voices move in pitch by the full interval and in formants by 40% of it, each with its own vibrato, drift and small delay, so they sound like separate singers. No in-between settings.

params.name: Param
params.comment: A parameter whose meaning follows the Shape (0..100). Sine: Lag (side voices ahead of / behind the main voice, on slightly different vowels). Step: Glide (hard steps .. smooth). Rand: Independence (0 all voices change together .. 100 each on its own clock). Solo: Soloists (1..4 voices move together each cycle, in turn). Some: Chance that a voice changes (10..90%). Canon: Lag, the entries are smeared in time. Ripl: Ripple speed (delay between voices). Fan: Glide (how fast the voices open and gather). Walk: Step size (small blends .. whole-vowel leaps). Swell: Attack (how much of the cycle the rise takes). Spot: Width of the spotlight.

params.name: Tempo
params.comment: BPM for the LFO, read straight off the knob so the screen number IS the tempo (40..240, below 40 acts as 40). The LFO restarts whenever it changes.

params.name: Shape
params.comment: LFO shape: 0 Sine (smooth sweep), 1 Step (hold a whole vowel, glide on), 2 Rand (every voice draws its own random vowels, on its own clock), 3 Solo (a few voices change per cycle, in turn, the others hold), 4 Some (each voice changes on its own chance), 5 Canon (all voices sing the same random melody, one cycle apart), 6 Ripl (one new vowel ripples through the voices one after another), 7 Fan (the voices open out into a vowel chord and gather again), 8 Walk (every voice steps a vowel up or down on its own), 9 Swell (slow eased crescendo, quick fall), 10 Spot (a spotlight of vowel travels through the voices). Depth sets how far the shape reaches.

params.name: Depth
params.comment: How far the LFO shape reaches from Vowel, 0..100 = 0..4 vowels (0 = the shape does nothing).
